title: NotificationAgentContractSchemas
description: Input/output contract schema bundle for the Notification Agent. Delivers permissioned, low-noise notifications for run status, gates, and failures; never invents events. See /contracts/agents/notification-agent.md.

input.description: A Harness NotificationEvent. Never authored ad hoc by an agent — always sourced from an authenticated Harness event.

artifact_refs.description: Sealed artifacts referenced by id only, never full payload.

channel_hints.description: Suggested delivery channels; subject to redaction/authorization policy.

output.description: Delivery receipts. Never a Knowledge Plane SoR artifact — a side-channel audit record only.
